brief:
Settlers set fire to agricultural land in the village of Jaljilyia, Shehab Wire reported. The attack destroyed crops on Palestinian-owned plots in the West Bank community.

The incident is part of an ongoing pattern of arson attacks targeting Palestinian farmers and their property across the occupied territory. Such incidents have intensified in recent years, with settlers frequently targeting harvest seasons when crops are most vulnerable. Palestinian farmers say the attacks aim to drive them from their land and prevent agricultural development in areas bordering Jewish settlements.
title: Settlers torch farmland in Jaljilyia village
